headline_stat.name: median classic OSI in V1 (cortex vs LGd noise-corrected gOSI 0.221 vs 0.096, p=6e-5)

stated_limitation: Unit counts are very unequal across areas because probe placement targeted cortex, so LGd is the most sparsely sampled structure here and its confidence intervals are correspondingly wide. Subtracting a per-unit permutation noise floor corrects the leading rate-dependent bias in gOSI but is not a complete correction. Receptive-field position relative to the monitor is not controlled, so units whose receptive field falls near the screen edge see a truncated grating; this adds noise to the tuning estimates in every area.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000021 (Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels) is the canonical known-good dataset for orientation selectivity, used in the standard species, regions, and paradigm.
justification.handling: Real NWB files streamed from S3, explicit Allen-recommended QC thresholds, per-probe invalid-times exclusion, blank-sweep baseline, and correctly truncated non-overlapping counting windows.
justification.analysis: Uses proper circular statistics (doubled-angle vector OSI and Jammalamadaka correlation), a preferred-TF-matched permutation null with noise-floor correction, cross-validated decoding, a periodic-basis Poisson GLM, and multiple orthogonal controls.
justification.correctness: Every reported number traces to committed code and stats_summary.txt, the metrics are internally consistent across figures and statistically sound (adequate n, permutation and held-out tests), and none are physically impossible.
justification.figures: Figures show the effect clearly with units, sample sizes, and honestly-chosen representative (median) examples, and the artifact-prone high-gOSI cases are explicitly flagged rather than passed off as typical.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, the graded cortex-vs-thalamus story is stated with nuance, the gOSI positive bias is called out and controlled, and specific real limitations are named.
